book.hypercluster.hypercluster_manual.la: This manual covers the HV through IV computing chain currently implemented in GregTech HyperCluster.$(br2)It walks through gathering telemetry from HV ore washing and burning edge chips, purifying datasets with LoRA fine-tuning and red-team alignment in EV, and scaling into either an IV air-cooled datacenter or a closed-source cloud satellite station.$(br2)Check EMI / JEI for full recipe lookups and multiblock previews.

hypercluster.machine.data_scrubbing_towe: Fractions raw telemetry logs into high-purity datasets. Also formats corrupted noise back into raw silicon.
hypercluster.machine.ev_telemetry_chemic: Settles chemical telemetry against real outputs. Base recipe: circuit #1. Chip recipe: circuit #2 (chip is not consumed, half the aluminium dust).
hypercluster.machine.hv_micro_burner.too: Burns edge chips from telemetry logs and high-purity domain datasets on blank carriers.
hypercluster.machine.hv_telemetry_ore_wa: Settles telemetry against real outputs. Base recipe: circuit #1. Chip recipe: circuit #2 (chip is not consumed).
Inference chip: ordinary domain edge chips serve 2 CWU/t recipes, aligned chips up to 8 CWU/t.
IV inference coprocessor hatch: pulls real CWU/t through optical pipes to run boosted tower recipes (25%/50% less EU/t).
hypercluster.machine.local_fallback_gate: Idle: attach me to a satellite station's frame.
Standing by: rounds blocked by 429 / funds / retired models run here locally.
IV local fallback gateway: attached to a satellite station it takes over rounds blocked by 429 limits, empty Token balances or retired models, running them locally at degraded speed with no billing.
hypercluster.machine.lora_engraving_cham: Engraves domain LoRA cards from high-purity datasets plus golden samples on blank carriers.
hypercluster.machine.precision_crac.tool: Precision CRAC: a running unit within 8 blocks upgrades a compute rack room to Tier II (PUE 1.45).
hypercluster.machine.red_team_sandbox.to: Red-teams ordinary edge chips against corrupted noise. Validated chips come out aligned.
hypercluster.telemetry_buffer.full: Buffer full: further settled batches drop their logs.
hypercluster.telemetry_buffer.tooltip: Telemetry log buffer: %s / %s. One log per settled batch.
item.hypercluster.aligned_chemical_edge_: Passed red-team adversarial validation. Stable circuit #4 chemical recipes at 25% less energy.
item.hypercluster.aligned_mining_edge_ch: Passed red-team adversarial validation. Stable circuit #4 mining recipes at 25% less energy.
item.hypercluster.api_credential_card.to: Bind it against a satellite station controller, then keep it in the station's credential slot to operate your cloud account.
item.hypercluster.api_credential_card.un: Unbound — use it on a satellite station controller.
item.hypercluster.blank_carrier.tooltip: Read-only carrier used to burn telemetry logs into an edge chip.
item.hypercluster.chemical_edge_chip.too: Edge-inference chip for the chemical domain. Unlocks reagent-saving recipes.
item.hypercluster.chemical_lora_card.too: Domain fine-tune card engraved from high-purity chemical data. Circuit #3 recipes.
item.hypercluster.chemical_telemetry_log: Recorded by a chemical machine when a tracked recipe batch settles. Scrub it in the data tower.
item.hypercluster.clean_dataset.tooltip: Interference-free residue of telemetry scrubbing. Formats blank carriers.
item.hypercluster.corrupted_noise.toolti: Unreadable telemetry garbage. Recycle it in the data tower for raw silicon.
item.hypercluster.golden_dataset.tooltip: Golden-labelled samples exhaled by the scrubbing tower. Perfect engraving grade.
item.hypercluster.green_snack_pack.toolt: Machine-room mascot snack. Keep one in the compute rack slot for tidy efficiency.
item.hypercluster.high_purity_chemical_d: Domain dataset refined from chemical telemetry. Burns chemical chips.
item.hypercluster.high_purity_mining_dat: Domain dataset refined from mining telemetry. Burns mining chips fast.
item.hypercluster.iv_compute_blade.toolt: Hot-swappable IV air-cooled compute blade. Each grants 6 CWU/t in a compute rack.
item.hypercluster.mining_edge_chip.toolt: Edge-inference chip burned from telemetry. Unlocks enhanced ore-processing recipes.
item.hypercluster.mining_lora_card.toolt: Domain fine-tune card engraved from high-purity mining data. Circuit #3 recipes.
item.hypercluster.mining_telemetry_log.t: Recorded by an ore-processing machine when a tracked recipe batch settles.
item.hypercluster.token_credit_card.tool: Carries Tokens between your pocket and a satellite station's card slot.
